issue: Exported quantities disagreed with the validated sheet after row removal or reprocessing.
cause: Literal export overrides replayed edits.new_value by positional row index. Deleting an intermediate row shifted saved rows while historical audit paths retained old positions.
change: Use saved row/header JSON selected with production_rows in the same SQLite snapshot. Audit identifies explicitly written fields but its payload is never replayed into an export. Applies to CPIS, standard Excel and the Excel preview.

regressions: literal text, intentional blanks and zero
concurrent edits cannot overwrite the selected export snapshot

other_applications: Perfis and Cantoneiras export their saved validation data through a different implementation and do not replay edits.new_value.
